name: LODO cross-dataset selection
selection: For each held-out dataset, maximize mean mAP on the other three datasets across all three backbones.
evaluation: Apply the fold-selected configuration unchanged to all three backbones of the held-out dataset.
constraints: Held-out labels and retrieval metrics are not used during selection.
The number of refinement rounds is fixed to two.
No label-based best-iteration selection is permitted.
